doc.name: DayHeart
doc.instructions: DayHeart is the user's control panel and memory for their day: work shifts with earnings, university classes with homework, and tasks. The user connected it so that what you find or do for their day is kept there, on all their devices: save the tasks, deadlines, homework and classes you find or agree on with the user to DayHeart, and use it when they ask about their schedule or to-dos. Whatever you add or change is marked in DayHeart as made by an AI. Every tool reads or changes the user's own DayHeart, so the first tool call asks the user to sign in to DayHeart. Dates are days in the user's time zone, YYYY-MM-DD. Homework for a class goes into that class with change_study (add_homework, or set_homework for a short line plus details; in a shared group timetable the whole group sees it), never into tasks; other to-dos, such as academic debts, are tasks (change_tasks). class_id comes from get_classes, where "shared": true means a group timetable; check get_classes before add_class so a class is not added twice. Files for a class or subject (notes, tests, slides): DayHeart keeps links, not files — put the file on the user's cloud drive (for example Google Drive, folder DayHeart › Study › subject) and attach its link with change_study add_material, in a folder (for example "Tests", "Lectures") when there are many. For a shared group timetable make the file viewable by anyone with the link, or classmates will only see "Request access". To finish a task, complete it rather than delete it. delete cannot be undone: use it only when the user asked to delete something. Answer in the user's language.

tools.name: get_day
tools.title: My day
tools.description: Everything on one day: work shifts, classes, tasks and what the shifts earned.

tools.name: get_shifts
tools.title: Work shifts
tools.description: Work shifts in a date range with job, start and end time and, if allowed, the money each shift earned.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 92 days after from. Default: a week from "from"

tools.name: get_classes
tools.title: Classes
tools.description: Classes (university or school timetable) in a date range: subject, time, room, teacher, homework, materials (links); subjects the user marked closed, with their result; and materials attached to whole subjects.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 92 days after from. Default: a week from "from"

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.title: Tasks
tools.description: Tasks with a date in a date range, done or not, and open tasks without a date (inbox, newest first, up to 50).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 92 days after from. Default: a week from "from"

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.title: Earnings
tools.description: Money earned by work shifts in a date range, in total and per job (overtime included), before tax; net after tax and fixed salary when the person set them. Default: this month so far.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 92 days after from. Default: a week from "from"

tools.name: change_tasks
tools.title: Change tasks
tools.description: Add, change, complete or reopen a task in DayHeart. add needs a title (date and time optional; time needs a date). update changes the title, date, time, length, important or urgent. complete marks the task done; reopen marks it not done. Notes and private tasks are not available.

action.description: What to do with the task

id.description: Task id, for update, complete and reopen

title.description: What to do, up to 180 characters

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; empty string removes the date

time.description: HH:MM, 24-hour; needs a date; empty string removes the time

duration_minutes.description: How long the task takes, 1 to 1440 minutes; only with a time

tools.name: change_study
tools.title: Change classes and homework
tools.description: Change the user's timetable and homework in DayHeart. add_class adds a class once, every week or every other week until a date. add_homework adds homework on a new line of a class's homework (the same text is not added twice). set_homework replaces it with a short line (what and for when) and optional details; clear_homework removes it. close_subject marks a subject closed with its result; reopen_subject opens it again. add_material attaches a link to a class (class_id) or to the whole subject (subject): DayHeart keeps links, not files, so put the file on the user's cloud drive first and attach its link; remove_material removes one (material_id or url). In a shared group timetable the whole group sees classes, homework and materials; a closed subject is the user's own mark.

class_id.description: id of the class, for homework or a material of this class

subject.description: Subject as in the timetable, e.g. "Anatomy (Pr)": the class to add, the class for homework when there is no class_id, the subject to close or reopen, or the subject a material belongs to

url.description: For add_material: https link to the file or page (for example a Google Drive file). In a shared place of study the whole group opens it, so the file must be viewable by anyone with the link; the answer says access "closed" if it is not. For remove_material: the link to remove

title.description: For add_material: name to show, up to 120 characters, e.g. "Lecture 3.docx"

folder.description: For add_material: folder inside the subject's materials, e.g. "Tests" (empty: no folder); for a link that is already there, moves it

material_id.description: For remove_material: id of the material, as listed with the class or subject

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the (first) day of a new class, or the day of the class the homework is for

start.description: HH:MM, 24-hour: start of a new class

end.description: HH:MM, 24-hour: end of a new class

repeat.description: once (default), weekly or biweekly, for a new class

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD: last day for weekly or biweekly; at most 90 classes

room.description: Room or building, as the user writes it

kind.description: Kind of class: lecture, practice, lab or seminar

place.description: Place of study (group) name; needed only when the user has several

text.description: Homework: the text to add (up to 1000 characters), or for set_homework the short line, what and for when (up to 300)

details.description: For set_homework: everything else about the homework, up to 4000 characters

result.description: For close_subject: passed as a credit, with a grade, or without a result

grade.description: For close_subject with a grade: the grade as the user says it, up to 12 characters

tools.name: delete
tools.title: Delete a task or a class
tools.description: Delete a task or a class from DayHeart for good. This cannot be undone; in a shared group timetable the class disappears for the whole group.

annotations.title: Delete a task or a class
